name: Colour tools
author: Alfie
description: Converts colours between hex, RGB and HSL (and CSS colour names), checks text contrast against the WCAG accessibility guidelines, and makes palettes: tints and shades, complementary, triadic and analogous colours. Handy for design and web work.

tools.name: convert_colour
tools.description: Show a colour as hex, RGB and HSL, and its nearest CSS colour name. Accepts #rgb, #rrggbb, rgb(…), hsl(…) or a CSS name like teal.

tools.name: contrast_check
tools.description: The contrast ratio between text and background colours, and whether it passes WCAG AA and AAA for normal and large text.

tools.name: make_palette
tools.description: Make a palette from a colour: shades (lighter to darker), complementary, triadic, analogous, or split (split-complementary).
